restructures.reason: Law establishing Halabja Governorate (قانون استحداث محافظة حلبجة) passed by the Council of Representatives on 2025-04-14, ratified by presidential decree on 2025-04-29 and published in the Official Gazette on 2025-05-05; Federal Supreme Court challenges rejected. OCHA COD-AB v01 still lists Halabja as a district of Sulaymaniyah, so the OCHA district and its four sub-districts move unchanged under a new governorate (new IQG19 codes; ochaCode keeps the OCHA P-codes). Federal sources list the sub-districts as Sirwan, Khurmal, Biyara and Bamo; OCHA has Biyara, Khurmal, Markaz Halabja and Shahrazur, so the placement of Shahrazur is unconfirmed and Sirwan/Bamo have no OCHA geometry. No ISO 3166-2 code is confirmed by ISO (Wikidata lists IQ-HA), so isoCode stays null.

2024 census (COSIT, reference date 2024-11-25) organisation of Al-Anbar: new districts and sub-districts the census lists and OCHA COD-AB v01 does not, and sub-districts the census places under another district of the same governorate (they take a code under that district; ochaCode keeps the OCHA P-code). New units have no open boundary; carvedFrom names the OCHA sub-district each was taken from.
